title: viola palmata var. villosa
intro: Viola palmata var. villosa, commonly known as the hairy violet, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the violet genus. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its use as an anti-inflammatory agent and its ability to relieve anxiety and stress due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Viola palmata var. villosa include sedative and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as insomnia and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
